decisions.promotion_reason_summary: An approved SNAP E&T plan is authoritative for the bounded E&T plan, but it does not by itself identify the complete operative state SNAP implementation authority and version required by this field.
A federal fiscal-year assignment for specified E&T changes does not by itself establish the complete state implementation effective date required by this field.
